tasks.label: Focused validation
tasks.command: node --check server.js && node --check src/config.js && node --check src/db.js && node --check scripts/init-db.js && node --check scripts/seed-data.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); const dir=path.join('src','locales'); const files=fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.toLowerCase().endsWith('.json')).sort(); for(const f of files) JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,f),'utf8')); console.log('Parsed package.json and '+files.length+' locale JSON files: '+files.join(', '));" && npm run db:init -- --seed && npm run db:init -- --seed

tasks.label: Inspect GitHub publishing setup
tasks.command: git status --short; git remote -v; git ls-remote https://github.com/RohitKhobare/AutoClaim-AI-Demo.git HEAD

tasks.label: Check remote and Git credentials
tasks.command: git config --global --get credential.helper; git ls-remote https://github.com/RohitKhobare/AutoClaim-AI-Demo.git HEAD; Write-Output "git exit: $LASTEXITCODE"

tasks.label: Prepare public repository commit
tasks.command: git init -b main; git remote add origin https://github.com/RohitKhobare/AutoClaim-AI-Demo.git; git add -A; git status --short
